custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the spatial grounding of the legs using depth cues, as keypoint detection will fail due to water occlusion. image_description: A large pelican (likely a Brown Pelican) standing in shallow, turquoise water. The bird features a massive, elongated bill with a prominent gular pouch, a white head and neck with a crest, and a body covered in dark grey/brown plumage. Its legs are visible standing on the submerged ground, casting a shadow, but fine details of the feet are obscured by water refraction.
